packageRules.description: Upgrade the platform as one unit: every @marinoscar/platform-* package in apps/cloud moves to the same version in one pull request.
The `next` pre-release channel is opt-in: set `followTag` to `next` here to receive pre-releases (see apps/cloud/README.md, Upgrading).

apps/desktop pins every dependency to an exact version, Electron above all (docs/specs/desktop.md section 3.2). Renovate opens each bump as a pull request; an Electron bump must pass the packaged end-to-end suite.
